SELECT r.id AS id, r.report_no AS reportNo, p.paper_title AS paperTitle, u.real_name AS studentName, t.check_rate AS similarity, t.end_time AS checkTime, t.check_status AS status
ORDER BY r.create_time DESC

SELECT COUNT(*) AS totalReports, IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN t.check_status = 'completed' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS completedReports, IFNULL(ROUND(AVG(t.check_rate), 2), 0) AS averageSimilarity, IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN t.check_rate > 30 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS highRiskReports
